definitions.explanation: A paper or sheet on which answers are written for an examination or test. Can refer to both the blank sheet and the completed answers.

examples.japanese: {答案|とうあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}→提出：03542_teishutsu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
{答案|とうあん}⟦{用紙|ようし}→用紙：09588_youshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please write your name on the answer sheet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{答案|とうあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{採点|さいてん}→採点：04160_saiten⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The teacher is grading the exam papers.

notes:
USAGE: {答案|とうあん} specifically refers to written answers on examination papers. It's commonly used in school and testing contexts.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {答案|とうあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ (to write answers)
- {答案|とうあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}→提出：03542_teishutsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to submit answer sheets)
- {答案|とうあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{採点|さいてん}→採点：04160_saiten⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to grade answer sheets)
- {答案|とうあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{返却|へんきゃく}→返却：03149_henkyaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to return graded papers)
